product.name: Agentic Process Control Platform
product.description: A platform that autonomously manages complex industrial processes to optimize production throughput, energy efficiency, and emissions reduction.

product.name: AI Agents
product.description: Industrial AI agents that optimize process control systems to enhance plant performance, improve throughput, and reduce emissions.

product.name: Agent Builder
product.description: A tool to build, test, manage, and deploy customized AI agents for industrial applications.

product.name: Pre-trained Agents
product.description: Ready-to-use industrial agents designed for specific equipment to streamline deployment.

product.name: AI Co-Pilot
product.description: A virtual assistant that aids operations teams in optimizing production equipment settings.

product.name: Simulation Templates
product.description: Scalable templates for simulating industrial processes, facilitating quick onboarding of new equipment.
